test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E, and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. E is the immediate neighbour of B and D. F is to the immediate right of B, and second to the left of C. Where is A seated?

options.text: Second to the right of D
Third to the left of B
To the immediate right of C
To the immediate right of F

solution: According to the given information, 1) F is to the immediate right of B, and second to the left of C. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632277c72d6ec485572e268cf8b29e1446c174ed7494365706ce2163cabe5acb.png] 2) E is the immediate neighbour of B and D.
